title: Current PR Railway deployment impact, read-only pre-merge

verdict.prediction_ar: لا تطابق المسارات الحالية أي نمط مراقبة في الخدمات الـ24 ذات branch=main؛ لذلك لا يُتوقع بناء حاويات جديد من تطابق هذه الملفات مع الأنماط المقيسة، ما دامت إعدادات المصدر وأنماط المراقبة ثابتة. لا ندّعي أن حالات النشر الفعلية SKIPPED قبل قياس الدمج نفسه.

method.watch_matching: All 24 main and four alternate-branch services expose simple root-anchored exact-path or directory/** patterns. Each exact changed path was compared against every exposed pattern; no generic wildcard approximation was used.

docs.finding: Watch paths are gitignore-style; no matching changed path skips a new deployment. Paths remain relative to repository root despite a configured root directory.
Deployment config from code can override service settings without updating dashboard values; configuration resolution is a visibility boundary.

local_source_inspection.workflows: Search of all .github/workflows found Railway Dockerfile PR build only; the inspected workflow runs docker build, not Railway deploy/up/redeploy. No direct reference to the edited live acceptance scripts exists in workflow text. CI on main/pull_request still runs its checks.
local_source_inspection.live_acceptance_script: scripts/staging/ai_rag_live_acceptance.sh operates an existing docker-compose stack when explicitly invoked; optional --restart-rag restarts retrieval and --require-generation may write advice/tool audit/approval records. Editing or merging this script does not execute those flags.

copy_context_verification.note: COPY planner result belongs to initial 49-path snapshot. Refreshed watch matching covers all final paths; added paths are certification/evidence only.

visibility_limits: Three staging services (soil, ai-agronomist, weather) expose branch=main and watch patterns but omit source.repo; association to this repository is not fully represented by describe-service. Report the missing field instead of fabricating it.
Two sahool-migrate instances expose rootDirectory but neither repo nor branch nor an image source; they cannot be classified as main autodeploys from this metadata.

Four instances track other branches: production platform/auth, staging platform/tts. A main merge does not directly change those branches; subsequent branch updates or external automation are outside this estimate.

describe-service applies staged overlays, but all 43 service records here are state=live with staged=null and stagedChanges=[]. Environment pendingWork still exposes empty staged patches; that inconsistency remains unresolved.

Config-file location/per-deployment resolved configuration and external deploy triggers are not fully visible in these service snapshots. The tracked sole config file inspected has no watchPatterns override.

Repository CI build-planner enumerates 13 Dockerfiles; current Railway settings also include weather-service. Its Dockerfile was separately inspected and the changed paths match none of its COPY sources, so the zero-context conclusion does not rely on the incomplete 13-entry enumeration alone.
The 70 evaluated paths include the deployment-impact report and both additional review JSON files. Recompute the final merge diff if further paths are added.
No new PR merge SHA has been supplied yet. No actual post-merge deployment conclusion is made here.
Manual deployments, configuration changes, billing restoration, image restarts, PR preview environments and triggers outside production/staging are not ruled out.

list_deployments(project, staging, limit=50) without status filter

Poll only unresolved in-flight observations within a bounded interval; never reinterpret missing records as SKIPPED.
